title: The Olympic Games
kind: 说明文 · 奥运会的历史、举办城市与旗帜格言

timeline.text: The Olympic Games were an ancient athletic festival in Greece. Among the games held throughout Greece, the Olympic Games were the most famous.
They were held every four years.
The modern Olympic Games became popular in the late 19th century. In 1892, at a meeting in Paris, Pierre de Coubertin put forward the idea of holding Olympic Games again.
In 1894, the International Olympic Committee (IOC) was founded.
Modern Olympic Games include the Summer Olympics and the Winter Olympics.
The first modern Olympic Games were held in Athens, Greece, in 1896, while the first Winter Olympics were held in Chamonix, France, in 1924.
Since 1994, the Olympic Games have alternated between a summer and a winter edition every two years.
In 2008, Beijing became the first Chinese city to host the Games. Do you remember the slogan “One World, One Dream”?
The song You and Me touched many people’s hearts. In 2022, Beijing hosted the Winter Olympic Games.
It became the first city in the world to host both the Summer and the Winter Olympic Games.
The Olympic flag has a white background with five interlaced rings in blue, yellow, black, green, and red.
These rings symbolise the unity of the continents. The motto of the Olympic Games is “Faster, Higher, Stronger — Together”.
